items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: go down to Boyle Woods. We used to catch that train here in Allogies. ... Boyle Woods, Farley Town, that's when the ships be coming in from the Gulf.

ctx.x: Is that for carnival? That's carnival. Yeah.

Paid us $10 a man. For all day long? That's all day long from 6 to 6. Yeah, from 6 to 6. 6 in the morning? 6 to 6. We go up there all in the morning and bring them all around to pick up the gang. And then we start up. What do you mean? You're tired after that? Oh man, you're tired. I guess you're tired. Then walk up there and—no, we walk coming this way, then we walk back. That's two trips. That's about 60 some odd blocks, ain't it? Oh yeah, the time they go all around? Yeah. Way up on the other side of the park.…

Well, listen, Tom, when you were playing those long parades like that and you got towards the end, you were getting tired, did you play music a little easier for you to play or did you just keep playing the, I mean, did you have tunes that you thought were a little easier?
